priorityList: Maintain Raise Dead at all times.
Apply and maintain Virulent Plague using Outbreak, refreshing if it has fewer than 3 ticks remaining.
Cast Army of the Dead whenever available.
Cast Dark Transformation while Army of the Dead is active or if Army's cooldown is longer than 30 seconds.
Cast Soul Reaper on any target below 35% health.
Drop Death and Decay (Desecrate) if it is not already active on the ground to enable Scourge Strike cleave.
Use Festering Strike to refresh Festering Scythe or its debuff if they are about to expire (under 3 seconds).
Cast Festering Strike if you have 0 stacks of the 'Lesser Ghoul Ready' buff to prepare a Horseman summon.
Cast Scourge Strike (or Clawing Shadows) if you have 1 or more stacks of 'Lesser Ghoul Ready' to summon a Horseman.
Cast Putrefy on cooldown, prioritising windows where Dark Transformation is active or if you are at max charges.
Spend Runic Power on Epidemic (in AoE) or Death Coil (in ST) if you have fewer than 2 Runes available or a Sudden Doom proc.
Cast Epidemic as your primary spender if 4 or more enemies are present (or 3 if Whitemane is active).
Cast Death Coil as your primary spender if there are fewer than 4 enemies.
Use offensive Trinkets, Potions, and Racial abilities during Dark Transformation or while Horsemen are active.
Use Power Infusion (if received) during Dark Transformation or while your Army of the Dead is active.
